turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I implore you, gentlemen, to understand the gravity of my situation. My family's honor, nay, the very balance of power in Europe hangs in the balance.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Pray, proceed, Your Majesty. I am listening.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must warn you, Your Majesty, that I can only deal with facts and evidence. I am not a diplomat or a politician, but a detective.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I see, Your Majesty. You have a problem that requires discretion, I presume? I must insist that you provide me with all relevant details, no matter how sensitive they may be.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that I am intrigued by the gravity of your situation. Might I inquire, what specific action or event has put your family's honor at risk?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that my sister, Irene Adler, has, shall we say, compromised herself in a most... delicate situation, involving a prominent figure of the Imperial Court. I beg of you, gentlemen, to help me extricate her from this predicament, before it is too late.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I am deeply concerned, Your Majesty, about the welfare of your sister, and I must admit that I find the situation quite puzzling. Could you provide me with more information about the circumstances surrounding this delicate situation?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist on knowing the identity of this prominent figure of the Imperial Court, Your Majesty. His involvement will likely be the key to unraveling this tangled web.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that I am still unclear about the nature of your sister's involvement with this prominent figure. Could you, perhaps, shed some light on the circumstances that led to this... delicate situation?

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, that I am beginning to piece together a most intriguing puzzle. Might I suggest that a thorough examination of the letters and documents you have brought with you could provide us with valuable insights into the situation?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that I am at my wit's end. The thought of my sister's reputation being tarnished by this scandal is... unbearable.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear, gentlemen, that the matter is more complex than I initially let on. My sister's involvement with the lady in question is... a matter of family obligation, rather than any personal choice.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I implore you, gentlemen, to understand the gravity of the situation. The lady in question is not simply a woman of loose morals, but a figure of great influence and power, whose reputation could bring ruin to my family and, indeed, to the entire nation.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I observe, Your Majesty, that you are attempting to convey a sense of urgency and gravity to the situation. However, I notice that you have thus far avoided providing any concrete details about the lady in question, or the nature of your sister's involvement with her. I must insist on knowing more about these specifics, in order to fully understand the scope of the problem you are facing.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to understand that I am not at liberty to reveal certain... particulars about the lady in question. Suffice it to say that my sister's involvement with her has far-reaching consequences, and I fear for the very stability of our nation.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I shall not be swayed by your attempts to obscure the truth, Your Majesty. If the lady in question holds such great influence and power, I must know more about her, and the nature of her relationship with your sister. I warn you, I shall not rest until I uncover the facts, no matter how delicate or sensitive they may be.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, that I find myself somewhat perplexed by your reluctance to share more information about the lady in question. Might I suggest that, in the interest of clarity and understanding, you consider revealing a few more details to us?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I warn you, Your Majesty, that I shall not be deterred by your reluctance to share information. I require specifics, and I shall not rest until I have uncovered the truth.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I suggest, Your Majesty, that you reconsider your position and reveal more information about the lady in question. The longer you delay, the more I suspect that my powers of observation will uncover the truth through more... circuitous means. I warn you, I am not a man to be underestimated in my pursuit of knowledge.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must respectfully agree with Sherlock Holmes, Your Majesty. It is in the best interest of all parties involved that the truth be revealed, and I daresay that our conversation has already shed sufficient light on the gravity of the situation to warrant a more open discussion.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
